introduction: The following special conditions apply specifically to this project and supplement the standard terms.

terms.title: Permitted Development Route - Certificate of Lawful Development Only
terms.content: **Noble Architecture** is appointed to prepare and submit an application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for a Proposed Use or Operation under Section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. Noble Architecture is not appointed to prepare or submit a Householder Planning Application for this project, and no fee for one is included within the quotation. Should the Client subsequently instruct Noble Architecture to pursue a full planning application, that is a new instruction requiring a fresh quotation and a materially more extensive drawing and documentation package, which will be agreed in writing before any additional work is undertaken.

terms.title: Determination Rests With The Local Planning Authority
terms.content: **Noble Architecture** will assess the proposals against the criteria set out in Class A of Part 1 of Schedule 2 to the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), and will not knowingly submit a scheme that contravenes those criteria. Noble Architecture gives no warranty, express or implied, that the certificate will be granted. The determination of lawfulness rests solely with **Rushcliffe Borough Council** as the Local Planning Authority, and only that authority can issue the certificate.

terms.title: Submission Only - Transfer of Correspondence To The Client
terms.content: **Noble Architecture** is engaged on a submission only basis for this phase. Its appointment concludes upon submission of the application to Rushcliffe Borough Council. The Client's own contact details will be given as those of the applicant. The certificate, all notifications, and any query or request for further information raised by the case officer will therefore be issued directly to the Client rather than to Noble Architecture. Where the Local Planning Authority raises a matter that requires further design or drawing work, the Client shall notify Noble Architecture and that work will be quoted separately and agreed in writing before it is undertaken.

terms.title: Local Planning Authority & Method Of Submission
terms.content: The Local Planning Authority for this property is **Rushcliffe Borough Council**. Rushcliffe Borough Council accepts application forms and supporting documents submitted by email to planningandgrowth@rushcliffe.gov.uk, and Noble Architecture intends to submit by that route. Submitting directly to the Local Planning Authority rather than through the national Planning Portal avoids the Planning Portal upload service charge of £70.83 plus VAT (£85.00). Validation requirements and determination periods are set by the Local Planning Authority and are outside Noble Architecture's control.

terms.title: Statutory Application Fee
terms.content: The application fee for a Certificate of Lawfulness for a Proposed Use or Operation is set by Government at one half of the equivalent full application fee. For works of this type that fee is £274.00 under the fee schedule effective 1 April 2026, being one half of the £548.00 householder application fee. This fee is a pass-through expense payable to Rushcliffe Borough Council. It is not included within Noble Architecture's quoted design fees and is subject to annual indexation. Funds must be transferred to **Noble Architecture** and cleared at least one working day prior to the intended submission date.

terms.title: Demolition Of The Existing Conservatory
terms.content: The existing garden room conservatory to the rear of the property is to be demolished in its entirety prior to commencement of the new works. The permitted development assessment is made on the basis that this structure is removed in full and that no part of it is retained. Retention of any part of the existing conservatory, or any other addition to the property not disclosed to Noble Architecture, may alter the assessment of the proposals against the permitted development criteria. The Client must notify **Noble Architecture** before submission if that intention changes.

terms.title: Optional Agency Services - **Optional Add-On
terms.content: Where the optional agency service is appointed, this must be explicitly agreed in writing prior to submission of the application. **Noble Architecture** will then be named as the Client's agent on the application and will manage all dialogue with the Local Planning Authority, with the design fees adjusted accordingly.
